'''Claude Sabbah''' (born 30 October 1954) is a French mathematician and researcher at [[École Polytechnique]].

==Education==
Sabbah received his doctoral degree from [[Paris Diderot University]] in 1976 under the supervision of [[Lê Dũng Tráng]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=76381}}</ref>

== Selected publications ==

* ''Introduction to Stokes Structures'', Springer Verlag, 2012, {{isbn|978-3-642-31694-4}}<ref>{{cite book | url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-642-31695-1 | doi=10.1007/978-3-642-31695-1 | title=Introduction to Stokes Structures | series=Lecture Notes in Mathematics | date=2013 | volume=2060 | isbn=978-3-642-31694-4 }}</ref>
